properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (propagate.rs propagate_from, WalkItem). A path that set out from a node taking part in a line of reasoning may climb a DECOMPOSES (upstream) to its parent, and is never followed back down a DECOMPOSES (downstream) to a sibling, so two premises of one deliverable reach what rests on each and their totals differ (the stage-5 re-read: Premises 2, 5 and 6 each reached the same 66 nodes).
properties.name: A what-if from a statement of the reasoning climbs to the parent it decomposes and never fans back down to the parent's other parts
